name: standby-design-mcp

tools.name: generate_color_palette
tools.description: Generate a perceptually uniform OKLCH color palette from a brand color: 18-step scales for brand/surface/error/accents, semantic tokens (shadcn/ui compatible), light+dark modes. Returns a shareable standby.design/system URL and a compact summary. Always give that URL to the user — the link is the deliverable; it opens the live system in the browser. Use export_design_system for full CSS/Tailwind output.

url.description: Existing standby.design URL (or raw hash) to modify. Only this tool's section is changed; color/type/shape/icon/spacing settings from other tools are preserved. Omit to start fresh from defaults.

brandHex.description: Brand color as 6-digit hex, e.g. "#335A7F". The palette midpoint is derived from this.

themeName.description: Name of the design system (appears in exports and page title).

mode.description: "balanced": step 500 is always the perceptual midpoint (even light/dark distribution). "exact": step 500 keeps the input color's lightness.

chromaScale.description: Surface saturation 0–1 (0 = grey surfaces, 1 = vibrant). Default 0.25.

bgColorHex.description: Surface tint color as hex, or "auto" to derive from the brand color (default).

errorColorHex.description: Error/destructive color as hex, or "auto" to derive from the brand hue (default).

brandPin.description: Pin the primary token to the exact input hex instead of the palette step.

brandInvert.description: For pinned brand: mirror lightness in dark mode (e.g. black buttons in light mode, white in dark).

fgContrastMode.description: Text color strategy on colored backgrounds.

hex.description: Hex color. Omit to auto-derive from the brand color (requires autoHue or a preset name: Success/Warning/Info).

accents.description: Up to 3 additional named accent colors. Replaces the existing accent list when provided; pass [] to remove all accents. Default: Success/Warning/Info, auto-derived.

tools.name: generate_type_scale
tools.description: Generate a fluid typographic scale (CSS clamp() between 375px and 1920px viewports) with 11 levels (Display, H1–H6, Body L/M/S, Caption), Fontshare fonts, line heights and letter spacing. Returns a shareable standby.design/system URL and a summary table. Always give that URL to the user — the link is the deliverable. Use list_fonts to discover font slugs.

url.description: Existing standby.design URL (or raw hash) to modify. Only this tool's section is changed; color/type/shape/icon/spacing settings from other tools are preserved. Omit to start fresh from defaults.

scaleMode.description: "custom": compound ratio scale (default). "traditional": classical Renaissance point sizes per level.

ratio.description: Scale ratio for custom mode. Presets: 1.2 minor third, 1.25 major third, 1.272 golden-ratio-area (default, √φ), 1.333 perfect fourth, 1.618 golden ratio. The empirical perceptual corridor is 1.20–1.50.

mobileBaseSize.description: Mobile base size in rem (default = baseSize).

mobileRatio.description: Explicit mobile scale ratio. Omit to auto-derive from ratio and autoShrink.

autoShrink.description: Percent reduction for the auto-derived mobile ratio (default 25). Only used when mobileRatio is not set.

headingFont.description: Fontshare font slug for headings, e.g. "satoshi", "general-sans", "clash-display".

bodyFont.description: Fontshare font slug for body text.

monoFont.description: Font slug for code. System stacks: "system-mono", "consolas", "sf-mono".

lineHeightOverrides.description: Per-level line-height overrides, e.g. {"h1": 1.1, "body-m": 1.6}. Levels: display, h1–h6, body-l, body-m, body-s, caption.

letterSpacingOverrides.description: Per-level letter-spacing overrides in em, e.g. {"display": -0.05}.

traditionalAssignments.description: For traditional mode: desktop px size per level, e.g. {"display": 48, "h1": 36, ...}.

traditionalMobileAssignments.description: For traditional mode: mobile px size per level.

tools.name: generate_shape_tokens
tools.description: Generate shape tokens — radii, shadows, borders, focus rings — in one of four visual styles: "paper" (classic surfaces with layered shadows), "glass" (liquid glass), "neomorph" (soft neumorphism), "neobrutalism" (hard offset shadows). Returns a shareable standby.design/system URL and a summary. Always give that URL to the user — the link is the deliverable.

url.description: Existing standby.design URL (or raw hash) to modify. Only this tool's section is changed; color/type/shape/icon/spacing settings from other tools are preserved. Omit to start fresh from defaults.

borderRadius.description: Base radius in px; scales to a xs–xl radius set (default 8).

shadowColorHex.description: Custom shadow color as hex, or "auto" (default).

shadowOffsetX.description: Brutalist shadow X offset in px (default 2).

shadowOffsetY.description: Brutalist shadow Y offset in px (default 4).

borderColorHex.description: Custom border color as hex, or "auto" (default).

ringColorHex.description: Custom focus ring color as hex, or "auto" (default).

separationMode.description: How surfaces separate from the background.

tools.name: generate_icon_tokens
tools.description: Pick an icon set and generate icon sizing tokens (xs–2xl + stroke width). Either select a specific set or state style preferences and get a recommendation. Available sets: material-outlined, material-filled, lucide, phosphor-regular, phosphor-bold, phosphor-thin, phosphor-fill, solar-linear, solar-bold, solar-broken, tabler-outline, tabler-filled, radix. Returns a shareable standby.design/system URL and a summary. Always give that URL to the user — the link is the deliverable.

url.description: Existing standby.design URL (or raw hash) to modify. Only this tool's section is changed; color/type/shape/icon/spacing settings from other tools are preserved. Omit to start fresh from defaults.

set.description: Icon set variant id to select explicitly, e.g. "lucide-outlined". One of: material-outlined, material-filled, lucide, phosphor-regular, phosphor-bold, phosphor-thin, phosphor-fill, solar-linear, solar-bold, solar-broken, tabler-outline, tabler-filled, radix. Pass "auto" to clear the selection and use the recommendation instead.

style.description: Preferred icon style for the recommendation.

corners.description: Preferred corner style (sharp = corporate/precise, rounded = friendly).

snapTo4px.description: Round sizes to the 4px grid (default true).

tools.name: generate_space_tokens
tools.description: Generate spacing tokens (3xs–3xl), breakpoints, container widths, prose measure, and aspect ratios. Returns a shareable standby.design/system URL and a summary. Always give that URL to the user — the link is the deliverable.

url.description: Existing standby.design URL (or raw hash) to modify. Only this tool's section is changed; color/type/shape/icon/spacing settings from other tools are preserved. Omit to start fresh from defaults.

mode.description: "harmonic": multiples of the base (default). "geometric": compound ratio steps.

multiplier.description: Uniform scale factor on all tokens (default 1.0).

snap.description: Snap token values to a sensible grid (default true).

breakpoints.description: Replace the breakpoint list, e.g. [{"name":"sm","minPx":640},...]. Defaults: sm 640, md 768, lg 1024, xl 1280, 2xl 1536.

fluidMinVw.description: Lower fluid viewport anchor in px (default 375).

fluidMaxVw.description: Upper fluid viewport anchor in px (default 1920).

containers.description: Replace the container list. Defaults: prose 680, narrow 880, default 1200, wide 1440.

aspectRatios.description: Replace the aspect ratio list, e.g. [{"name":"video","w":16,"h":9}].

includeReciprocals.description: Also export flipped (portrait) variants of each ratio (default true).

tools.name: get_design_system
tools.description: Decode a standby.design URL (or raw hash) and return an overview of the full design system: color palette, type scale, spacing & layout, shape tokens, and icons — plus per-tool edit links. Always give the standby.design/system URL to the user — the link is the deliverable.

url.description: A standby.design URL or raw unified hash (e.g. from a previous generate_* call or copied from the browser).

tools.name: export_design_system
tools.description: Generate the full token code for a design system URL in one format: "css" (CSS custom properties incl. semantic shadcn/ui-compatible tokens), "tailwind" (Tailwind v4 @theme), "design-tokens" (W3C DTCG JSON — typography & spacing), "llm-briefing" (Markdown brief for AI code generation), or "font-embed" (Fontshare <link> snippet). Optionally restrict to specific sections. Always give the returned standby.design/system URL to the user alongside the code — the link is the deliverable.

url.description: A standby.design URL or raw unified hash.

sections.description: Which sections to include. Default: all configured sections (symbol only when configured).

tools.name: list_fonts
tools.description: List Fontshare font slugs usable in generate_type_scale (headingFont/bodyFont/monoFont), grouped by category. This is the bundled seed catalog — any valid Fontshare slug works even if not listed here.

instructions:
Tools for generating complete design systems with standby.design.
Typical flow: generate_color_palette → generate_type_scale → generate_shape_tokens / generate_icon_tokens / generate_space_tokens, passing the returned URL into each subsequent call so the sections accumulate. Every result includes a shareable standby.design/system URL the user can open to view and fine-tune the system visually.
Use export_design_system to get the full CSS / Tailwind v4 / W3C design tokens / LLM briefing for a URL, and get_design_system to inspect an existing URL.
All tools are pure and deterministic — no network access, no side effects.
